en.quote: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
en.riddle: I have given thee the charge of My heave-offerings
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וַיְדַבֵּר יְהוָה אֶֽל-אַהֲרֹן וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ, אֶת-מִשְׁמֶרֶת תְּרוּמֹתָי לְכָל-קָדְשֵׁי בְנֵֽי-יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ נְתַתִּים לְמָשְׁחָה וּלְבָנֶיךָ לְחָק-עוֹלָֽם
he.riddle: וַאֲנִי הִנֵּה נָתַתִּי לְךָ, אֶת-מִשְׁמֶרֶת תְּרוּמֹתָי
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
